findings.title: Soroban contract arithmetic can wrap around in release builds
A signer with an empty contexts map is treated as unlimited, not as authorizing nothing
remove_signer check in verify_context applies to every contract, and panics when no argument is given
WebAuthn verification does not check rpIdHash, the user-presence flag or the clientData type
Restricted signer's failed limit check panics and aborts __check_auth, blocking valid unrestricted signers in the same transaction
Self-referencing stored policy limits recurse without bound in verify_signer_limit_keys
